title: Apple says it will check iCloud items shared to "Anyone with the link" for "harmful content" in 27.3 OS versions, and may delete the content or disable accounts (Ryan Christoffel/9to5Mac)
summary: Ryan Christoffel / 9to5Mac: Apple says it will check iCloud items shared to “Anyone with the link” for “harmful content” in 27.3 OS versions, and may delete the content or disable accounts — iOS 27.3 adds lots of new iPhone features, and it also makes a change to how public iCloud links work …
contentText:
Ryan Christoffel / 9to5Mac :

Apple says it will check iCloud items shared to “Anyone with the link” for “harmful content” in 27.3 OS versions, and may delete the content or disable accounts   —  iOS 27.3 adds lots of new iPhone features, and it also makes a change to how public iCloud links work …
